title: hush_restore
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.12) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_restore, FR-23, FR-20; not routed yet. Upstream: adobe/tools/hush/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:314 HUSH.restore (entry hush_restore :337). CEP WNC_HUSH.restore (signed bridge). Contract keys are snake_case; the port translates the upstream camelCase keys (docs/adobe/phase-6b-reservations.md). Undo: the backup takes the cut sequence's name (original_name when the cut sequence is gone) and is opened; the cut version is kept, renamed '<name> (Hush cut HH:MM:SS)'. A missing backup is an error.

backup_id.description: the backup sequenceID (hush_cut readback backup.id; upstream `backupId`)

original_name.description: the name used when the cut sequence is not found (upstream `originalName`)

restored.description: the restored sequence's name (the backup's new name)

readback.description: {restored}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.
